Named USTB and BUIDL positions are $71.501 million and $4.806 million; total equity is $76.3091221907 million. Weights use named values divided by total equity and retain the $2,122.1907 residual, rather than renormalizing rounded positions. These are issuer-reported fund holdings, not independent examination. NC-113 remains blocked on source freshness: both exact keyed fund identities already exist, and the September 18 source is outside the dashboard admission window. Next evidence: a newly dated reconciled portfolio disclosure or independent same-checkpoint holdings and fund NAV capture. Neither a new review timestamp nor a duplicate manual dependency makes the live source current.
